description: This file contains Redux action creators for cloud-related functionalities in Mattermost, including fetching installation info, validating emails, retrieving cloud limits, usage statistics, and retrying failed fetches.

methods.name: getInstallation
methods.description: Fetches installation information asynchronously using Client4.

methods.name: validateBusinessEmail
methods.description: Validates a business email address asynchronously.

methods.name: validateWorkspaceBusinessEmail
methods.description: Validates the workspace business email asynchronously.

methods.name: getCloudLimits
methods.description: Dispatches actions to fetch cloud limits and handles success or failure.

methods.name: getMessagesUsage
methods.description: Dispatches actions to fetch message usage statistics.

methods.name: getFilesUsage
methods.description: Dispatches actions to fetch file usage statistics.

methods.name: getTeamsUsage
methods.description: Dispatches actions to fetch team usage statistics.

methods.name: getCloudPreviewModalData
methods.description: Fetches cloud preview modal data asynchronously.

methods.name: retryFailedCloudFetches
methods.description: Retries fetching cloud data for failed requests based on stored errors.
